# Pinned dependencies for coderio (main + dev extra).
#
# This file is generated from the current working venv to pin every transitive
# dependency to an exact version. CI installs from this file to guarantee
# reproducible builds — an upstream release that breaks langchain or deepagents
# can no longer turn CI red without a corresponding change here.
#
# Regenerate after adding/removing a dependency in pyproject.toml:
#   pip install -e ".[dev]"          # sync your venv to the new deps
#   pip freeze | grep -v '^-e ' | grep -v '^coderio==' | sort > requirements-dev.txt
#
# Then commit the updated file. Do NOT hand-edit the pinned versions below —
# the whole point is that they reflect a known-good venv state.
#
# Scope: main dependencies + [dev] extra (pytest/ruff/build/mypy).
# The [mcp] extra is intentionally NOT pinned here — it's opt-in and MCP users
# manage their own server deps (npx, node, etc.).
#
# Cross-platform note: pywin32 is excluded because it's Windows-only (required
# by the mcp package on Windows via a platform marker, but not published for
# Linux/macOS). If you regenerate and see pywin32, remove the line manually —
# keeping it breaks `pip install -r` on Linux/macOS CI.
